title: SDE1
description:
### **Position Overview**


We are looking for an autonomous, highly capable **Backend Engineer (2–4 Years Experience)** to accelerate the growth of our cloud\-native microservices ecosystem. In this role, you will transition from just writing code to actively taking ownership of end\-to\-end feature delivery, designing domain\-driven APIs, and optimizing system performance. You will work closely with senior architects to break down monolith architectures or build out new distributed modules, ensuring our systems remain scalable, fault\-tolerant, and highly available.### **Key Responsibilities**

* **Module Ownership:** Independently own the lifecycle of backend features—from scoping and architectural layout to implementation, automated testing, and production deployment.
* **Microservices Development:** Architect and implement high\-throughput, loosely coupled microservices utilizing **Java (11/17\+)** and **Spring Boot**.
* **Database Optimization:** Design scalable relational and non\-relational database schemas. Write, analyze, and optimize complex queries, indexes, and transactions to eliminate system bottlenecks.
* **Integration \& Messaging:** Implement asynchronous communications and event\-driven patterns between microservices using message brokers.
* **Code Quality \& Mentorship:** Champion clean code architectures (SOLID principles). Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews and mentor incoming junior engineers/interns on internal frameworks.
* **Resilience \& Testing:** Maintain high test coverage by writing extensive unit, integration, and component tests. Participate in designing failover strategies (retries, circuit breakers).

### **Required Technical Skills**

* **Core Java Mastery:** Strong expertise in Java (Java 11 or 17 preference), including deep familiarity with Functional Programming (Streams/Lambdas), Concurrency/Multi\-threading, and Memory Management.
* **Spring Ecosystem Expertise:** Advanced hands\-on experience with **Spring Boot**, Spring Cloud (Eureka, Config Server, OpenFeign), Spring Security, and Spring Data JPA / Hibernate.
* **Distributed Systems Foundations:** Proven experience developing and maintaining production microservices. Practical understanding of distributed problems (e.g., distributed tracing, handling network timeouts, idempotent APIs).
* **Data Management:** Proficient with relational databases (**PostgreSQL / MySQL**) and a solid understanding of connection pooling and transaction propagation rules.
* **CI/CD \& DevOps Foundations:** Familiarity with containerization (**Docker**) and deploying/debugging services in cloud environments.

### **Preferred / Highly Value\-Add Skills**

* Hands\-on experience with Event\-Driven architectures using **Apache Kafka**, **RabbitMQ**, or AWS SQS.
* Exposure to NoSQL databases (**Redis,** ) for caching and document storage.
* Experience tracking system health via Observability frameworks (**Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, or OpenTelemetry**).

### **Soft Skills \& Behavioral Traits**

* **Autonomy:** Ability to take a loosely defined product requirement, clarify ambiguities, map out tech requirements, and execute it efficiently without constant oversight.
* **Pragmatic Problem Solving:** Knows when to implement a quick, stable hotfix versus when to pause and advocate for code refactoring.
* **Active Collaborative Voice:** Comfortable presenting technical trade\-offs in sprint planning sessions and communicating clearly across teams.

### **Qualifications**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline.
* **Experience:** 2 to 4 years of proven professional software development experience focusing heavily on enterprise Java applications and backend microservices.

* Contract testing experience using Pact or Spring Cloud Contract.
* Accessibility testing knowledge including WCAG standards and Axe tools.

* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification.
* Experience in Financial Services, Banking, or regulated industry environments.
